zetaris:CREATE SCHEMASTORE VIEW ndc_hydromorphone_v2 WITH CONTAINER fda AS
SELECT r.product_ndc, r.labeler_name, r.brand_name, r.dosage_form, r.application_number, r.marketing_category, r.listing_expiration_date,
       concat_ws('; ', transform(r.active_ingredients, a -> concat(a.name, ' ', a.strength))) AS strength,
       concat_ws(' | ', transform(r.packaging, p -> p.package_ndc)) AS package_n

value.error: A view named "ndc_hydromorphone_v2" already exists in container "fda".
